Next week, I will join global leaders at the 2025 Sustainable Energy for All (SEforALL) Global Forum in Barbados to drive action on Sustainable Energy for Development. 

With a focus on Sustainable Energy for Equity, Security and Prosperity, this year's Forum presents a critical opportunity to shape bold partnerships; mobilize investments; and advance policy solutions that put energy at the heart of sustainable and human development.

In 2025, it is critical that we move from intent to impactful action. Beyond traditional approaches, UNDP is working with governments and partners to scale innovative financing - from blended finance to de-risking mechanisms - to ensure that capital flows where it is actually required.
 
I am looking forward to engaging with partners to discuss innovative and transformative sustainable energy solutions that are both effective and inclusive for everyone, everywhere.⚡️

What role do you think public-private partnerships should play in scaling clean energy financing for sustainable development?
